newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK EXPORTERS WANT GOVT PROTECTION IN ALBANIA.
newsitem.headline: GREEK EXPORTERS WANT GOVT PROTECTION IN ALBANIA.

text.p: Greek businessmen asked their government on Wednesday to take immediate action in support of their interests in troubled Albania.

"Apart from the Greek government's intervention there is need for a commitment by the Albanian government to protect Greek businessmen as part of signed bilateral agreements." the Association of Northern Greek Exporters (ANGE) said in a statement.
The ANGE has notified the Greek ministries of Industry and Foreign Affairs ahead of a scheduled visit of Albanian Prime Minister Baskim Fino to Athens on Wednesday.
"Damages, especially in southern Albania where the majority of Greek businesses reside, are huge and may only be accurately assessed after the situation has normalised," ANGE added.

It is urging the Albanian government to take measures aimed at effectively protecting foreign businesses operating in Albanian territory, noting that "Greek and other foreign investments in Albania contribute to conditions of peace and stability in the region and inhibit the wave of immigrants." --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301-3311812-4
